addons.readme_markdown:
# Discord Alerts & Webhook Bridge

> [!NOTE]
> FiestaPanel's Discord Alerts & Webhook Bridge operates entirely through outbound HTTPS webhooks. No bot token, Discord gateway client, or background daemon is required.

The **Discord Alerts & Webhook Bridge** connects your Minecraft server directly to your community Discord guild. When key server events occur—such as server startup, shutdown, player joins/leaves, or TPS drops—the bridge formats a rich Discord embed and delivers it instantly via your incoming webhook.

---

## Key Features

- **Instant Event Dispatch**: Low-latency notifications for server startup, graceful restarts, and shutdown events.
- **Player Attendance Tracking**: Optional join and quit announcements with player heads and timestamped activity logs.
- **Customizable Embed Aesthetics**: Configure your bot's display name, avatar icon, and hex color accents to match your server branding.
- **Integrated Test Ping**: One-Click connectivity verification directly within the FiestaPanel UI.
- **Zero Server Overhead**: Uses asynchronous Python worker threads so game tick rate (TPS) is never impacted.

---

## Server & Network Requirements

| Requirement | Specification | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Server Engine** | Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Fabric, or Vanilla | Supported |
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.12.x through 1.21.x | Compatible |
| **Server Plugins** | None required (Standalone) | Built-in |
| **Outbound Port** | HTTPS Port 443 to `discord.com` | Required |

---

## Setup & Configuration Guide

### 1. Create a Discord Webhook
1. In your Discord server, open **Server Settings** -> **Integrations** -> **Webhooks**.
2. Click **New Webhook**, name it (e.g., *FiestaSMP Gateway*), and choose your alert channel.
3. Click **Copy Webhook URL**.

### 2. Configure FiestaPanel
1. Navigate to **Panel Addons** -> **Installed Addons** -> **Discord Alerts**.
2. Paste your copied Webhook URL into the **Discord Webhook URL** field.
3. Choose your desired embed color accent (e.g., `#38bdf8` for Aero Blue).
4. Click **[ Test Ping ]** to verify delivery. You should immediately see a test embed appear in your Discord channel!
5. Click **[ Save Webhook Settings ]**.

---

## Configuration Reference

```json
{
  "webhook_url": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...",
  "bot_name": "FiestaPanel Gateway",
  "avatar_url": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-fiestasmp/FiestaPanel/main/assets/banner.png",
  "notify_start": true,
  "notify_stop": true,
  "notify_join": true,
  "embed_color": "#38bdf8"
}
```

---

## Troubleshooting

- **Error: Invalid or empty Webhook URL**: Ensure the URL begins with `https://discord.com/api/webhooks/`.
- **HTTP Status 404**: The webhook was deleted in Discord. Create a fresh webhook in your channel settings.
- **HTTP Status 429**: Discord rate limit exceeded. Avoid triggering manual test pings repeatedly within short intervals.

addons.readme_markdown:
# Dynmap & BlueMap Live Map Viewer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This addon requires an active Minecraft web map plugin installed on your server (such as **Dynmap**, **BlueMap**, **Squaremap**, or **Pl3xMap**).

The **Live Map Viewer** allows server administrators and players to inspect real-time world geometry, player locations, claims, and terrain structures directly inside FiestaPanel without opening external browser tabs.

---

## Key Features

- **Direct Dashboard Integration**: Embeds your live world map in an optimized, isolated iframe viewport.
- **Port Autodetection**: Automatically detects local web servers running on standard ports (`8123`, `8100`, `8085`, `8080`).
- **One-Click Fullscreen**: Expand map exploration to full monitor resolution with high-DPI canvas support.
- **Multi-Engine Support**: Native compatibility with Dynmap (2D/isometric), BlueMap (three.js 3D), Squaremap, and Pl3xMap.

---

## Required Server Dependencies

| Plugin | Port | Type | Download Link |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dynmap** | `8123` | Isometric / 2D Tiles | [SpigotMC Page](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/dynmap.274/) |
| **BlueMap** | `8100` | Full 3D WebGL Model | [Modrinth Page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluemap) |
| **Squaremap** | `8080` | High-Speed 2D Vector | [Modrinth Page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/squaremap) |

---

## Quick Setup Guide

1. Ensure **Dynmap** or **BlueMap** is installed in your Minecraft server's `/plugins/` folder and the server is running.
2. In FiestaPanel, navigate to **Live World Map** under the sidebar Addons section.
3. Click **[ Autodetect Port ]** or enter `http://localhost:8123` into the Map URL bar.
4. Click **[ Save ]** to persist your configuration.

addons.readme_markdown:
# Automated Server Scheduler & Cron

> [!NOTE]
> All scheduled routines execute via FiestaPanel's internal background timer loop. No system-level cron access or root permissions are required.

Keep your Minecraft server running smoothly 24/7 with automated maintenance routines, daily restarts, and recurring announcements.

---

## Key Features

- **Daily Maintenance Reboots**: Automated scheduled restart at your preferred off-peak hour (e.g., `04:00 UTC`) with countdown warnings.
- **World Auto-Save Protection**: Periodically triggers `/save-all flush` to ensure player inventory and chunk changes are safely committed to disk.
- **Broadcast Announcements**: Keep players informed with recurring chat notifications for Discord links, voting reminders, and rules.
- **One-Click Manual Execution**: Test or immediately trigger any scheduled routine from the panel UI.

---

## Default Scheduled Tasks

| Task | Timing | Action | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Daily Reboot** | `04:00 UTC` | `/say Server rebooting...` + restart | Clears memory leaks and restores performance |
| **Community Broadcast** | `Every 30m` | `/say ✦ Join our community Discord server! ✦` | Player engagement |
| **Hourly World Flush** | `Every 60m` | `/save-all` | Prevents data loss on unexpected power cuts |

addons.readme_markdown:
# Server Maintenance Gate & Auto-Lock

> [!CAUTION]
> When Maintenance Mode is active, all non-whitelisted players attempting to connect will receive the custom kick message. Operators (`/op`) bypass the gate automatically.

The **Maintenance Gate** allows administrators to isolate their server during sensitive maintenance operations such as world migrations, database upgrades, or plugin configuration overhauls.

---

## Key Features

- **One-Click Master Toggle**: Switch between *Normal Mode* and *Maintenance Lockdown* in seconds.
- **Custom Kick Screen**: Design multi-line kick notices informing players of estimated return times and Discord update links.
- **Automated Broadcast**: Sends clear in-game alerts when maintenance begins and concludes.
- **Operator Bypass**: Server operators retain full connection access to test changes before reopening to the public.

# Episode World Archiver & Archive.org Publisher

> [!NOTE]
> The Episode World Archiver packages world files (`world`, `world_nether`, and `world_the_end`) into fast-compressed zip packages and provides native streaming upload to the Internet Archive (archive.org).

## Overview

Designed for SMP creators who release episodic world downloads to their viewers. Capture clean Pre-Episode and Post-Episode states, coordinate premiere releases with your Google Calendar, and let FiestaPanel automatically publish download links in-game and on Discord when the time comes!

## Features

- **Before & After Recording Snapshots**: Dedicated buttons execute `save-all flush` and package dimensions safely.
- **Internet Archive S3 Integration**: High-speed chunked uploads directly to archive.org collections.
- **Calendar Sync**: Integrates with FiestaPanel Event Manager and Google Calendar ICS feeds.
- **Scheduled Releases**: Download links remain locked until the scheduled premiere time, then auto-unlock with in-game chat broadcasts.
